subject.title: message tool: Feishu send action polluted by poll schema/guard prevents file send

question: Should the shared `message` tool hide/scope/sanitize poll creation fields for ordinary `send`, or should content-bearing poll fields continue to make `send` fail?
rationale: Current code intentionally fixes metadata-only padding but leaves the broader model-facing schema and content-field guard behavior unresolved; choosing the permanent contract changes tool semantics across channels.

options.title: Scope poll fields by action
options.body: Expose poll creation fields only for the `poll` action or channel-specific poll surfaces, reducing accidental model fill while keeping strict poll validation.

options.title: Strip poll fields on send
options.body: Keep the unified schema but sanitize poll creation params from `action="send"` before the guard or channel dispatch.

options.title: Keep current strict guard
options.body: Accept the shipped metadata-only fix and require new live evidence before changing how content-bearing poll fields are handled on `send`.

recommendation.title: Scope poll fields by action
recommendation.body: Expose poll creation fields only for the `poll` action or channel-specific poll surfaces, reducing accidental model fill while keeping strict poll validation.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent same-path outbound and poll parsing history makes this the strongest available owner for the cross-channel tool-contract choice.
